description: A number \(n\) has an accepted certified proof if and only if some stage of the specified enumeration outputs \(n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.enumeration_exact
  (P : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.ProofPresentation) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Provable P n ↔
    ∃ t, Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.enumerate P t = some n
